notes: GitClient Process pattern: spec references 'L193-209' which closely matches actual lines 192-206 (Process()+executableURL pattern). The pattern uses /usr/bin/env rather than direct binary paths, but the spec claim is about the pattern of spawning external commands via Process — this is accurate as a reusable analog for spawning /usr/bin/zip directly.

WKWebView iframe sandbox semantics (sandbox without allow-same-origin → null-origin iframe → no access to parent's webkit.messageHandlers) is the standard WebKit security model. The tech-spec acknowledges (Decision 3, Risks table) that this is 'untested without spike per user opt-out' and adds defense-in-depth via frameInfo.isMainFrame guard. This best-effort architectural assertion is appropriately hedged in the document itself.

Anthropic tool_use API: model claude-sonnet-4-6 with anthropic-version 2023-06-01 already used in production for streamCompletion + extractSingleChunk. The tools field shape ({name, description, input_schema}) used in the verify-smoke curl is a documented Anthropic Messages API capability (available since 2024). Cannot fully verify the tools field shape without making a live API call, but the parameters in the curl example match Anthropic's public documentation.

All Files-to-modify and Files-to-read paths in implementation tasks point to real existing paths (or correctly-marked new files: InsightCache.swift, InsightArchiveExporter.swift, vendor/js/chart-4.4.x.min.js, vendor/MANIFEST.txt, Tests/Fixtures/insight-skeleton-sample.json).
